name: cache-stats
description: Your prompt cache above the prompt: how long it stays warm, the hit rate, what a cold restart re-caches, and how long the session has run. /cache shows every miss and why.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a reply: 1h on a Claude subscription, 5m on an API key. Only the countdown and the expired-or-changed label depend on it; the hit rate is measured.
